chapter: Billie Holiday with the band (1971 session)
title: Billie's dark make-up at the Fox Theater in Detroit
summary: Kuehl asks about the story in Billie's book that she darkened her skin because she was considered too light to sing with a black band; Basie says he does not know.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Billie Holiday as the musicians knew her

blocks.x: Was it true what she said in her book about having to wear dark make-up in Detroit (inaudible) because she was too light at that time, considered too light for Fox Theater?
There was Fox Theater and there was some (inaudible) with what you say it was or dancers -- there's a whole thing, you know, like Radio City almost, or something.
She said that (inaudible) that you said that she had to darken her face because she was at that time, she was too light to sing with a black band, considered too light?
I don't know. Maybe it happened.
I just heard her sing. She (inaudible) I didn't know anything about, see?
